name: researchly-lsp
description: Section-aware, explainable writing suggestions for scientific documents (.qmd, .md, .tex). Runs the local Researchly language server — nothing leaves your machine.

researchly.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run the Researchly language server (needs spaCy + pygls installed).

researchly.prototypePath.description: Path to the folder containing the `researchly` package (packages/core in the repository).
